tasks.short: She coordinates neurological services with the health care team.

steps.what: Coordinate neurological services with other health care team activities.
inputs: what the health care team is already doing
outputs: how neurological services fit those team activities

tasks.design: She still coordinates neurological services with the other health care team's activities while she is with them. That fit is the work. No second note and no outside message are added.
tasks.previous_blocker: How neurological services fit the team's other activities depends on this patient's course, which changes from one day to the next.
tasks.enabler_now: Consult notes, medicine checks, and committee-approved protocol texts in this group are other tasks. Coordinating neurological services with the team stays with her.
tasks.still_hard: A ward plan that is already full, and a neurological need that cannot wait for the next round.
tasks.human_edge: She can tell which team activity must move and which one can stay, from the patient in front of her.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still coordinates neurological services with the health care team. She gains no right to set that fit from a timetable she has not worked through with them.

reach.task: Carry out the neurological plan on the ward
reach.learn: Which timing she set with the team, and which one the ward can still change

evidence.claim: Coordinating neurological services with the health care team is her conversation about this patient's course. A consult note is a different task.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the coordination happens in the meeting or call with the team. No structured feed is read, and no producer is added.
If the team is not in the room, she calls them. That call is the same coordination, not a second entry.
She does not keep a separate coordination note in this task. The team's own work stays theirs.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
The coordination keeps its full share. Nothing in this task is removed.
unknowns: Whether a ward coordinator already sets the timetable before she arrives.
research_questions: Which team activities does she still have to settle with them in the room?

already_counted.description: She still coordinates neurological services with the health care team's activities.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still coordinates neurological services with the team for this patient. No step in this task is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: She advises other physicians on neurological problems.

steps.what: Advise other physicians on the treatment of neurological problems.
inputs: the other physician's account of the problem
what she already knows of the patient's neurology

tasks.design: She still advises the other physician on the treatment of the neurological problem, in the conversation where she hears it. The advice stays hers. This task does not issue a letter, so there is no send to gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: The treatment advice depends on the problem the other physician describes, and on what she judges that problem to be.
tasks.enabler_now: Record questions and patient-education texts in this group are other tasks. Advising another physician on a neurological problem stays with her.
tasks.still_hard: A problem that sounds routine and is not, once she has heard the course.
tasks.human_edge: She can tell which treatment fits this neurological problem and which one the other physician should not start.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still advises other physicians on the treatment. She gains no right to let a prepared answer stand in for that advice.

reach.task: Ask her about a neurological problem
reach.learn: Which findings she needs before she will advise on treatment

evidence.claim: Advising another physician on treatment of a neurological problem is her judgement of that problem. A record question-and-answer tool is a different task.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the advice is the conversation with the other physician. No structured feed is read, and no producer is added.
If they are not in the same room, she takes the call. That call is the same advice, not a letter.
This task does not include a signed letter to an outside clinician. No send is removed.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
The advice keeps its full share. Nothing in this task is removed.
unknowns: Whether some of this advice already leaves as a letter another role types.
research_questions: Which neurological problems does she still have to hear from the other physician before she advises?

already_counted.description: She still advises other physicians on the treatment of neurological problems.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still advises the other physician after she has heard the neurological problem. No step in this task is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: She participates in continuing education to keep competence.

steps.what: Participate in continuing education activities to maintain and expand competence.

tasks.design: She still participates in the continuing education activity, and she still maintains and expands her own competence by being there. A committee-approved protocol text is a different task. This one stays with her.
tasks.previous_blocker: What she must maintain or expand depends on the activity and on the gaps in her own practice.
tasks.enabler_now: Committee-approved protocol texts in this group are other tasks. Participating in the activity, and maintaining and expanding competence, stay with her.
tasks.still_hard: An activity that covers a topic she already knows, and one that changes what she should do on Monday.
tasks.human_edge: She can tell which part of the activity changes her competence and which part she already practises.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still participates in the continuing education and still maintains and expands her competence. She gains no right to count attendance she did not do.

reach.task: Attend the same continuing education activity
reach.learn: Which part of the competence stays hers to maintain after the session

evidence.claim: Participating in a continuing education activity, and maintaining and expanding competence, is her attendance and learning. A committee-approved protocol text is a different task.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: she attends the activity. No course catalogue is added, and no producer feeds her a summary.
If a session is remote, she still attends it. That attendance is the same participation.
She does not log a completion in a second system in this task. No send is removed.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
The participation keeps its full share. Nothing in this task is removed.
unknowns: Whether her employer already records the activity in a learning system she does not touch.
research_questions: Which continuing education activities does she still have to attend herself?

already_counted.description: She still participates in the activity and still maintains and expands her competence.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still participates in the continuing education activity and still maintains and expands her competence. No step in this task is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: She orders supportive care, therapy, nursing, and social services.

steps.what: Order supportive care services such as physical therapy, specialized nursing care, and social services.
inputs: the patient's need for supportive care
the {OTHER} clinical record she already uses
outputs: her order for physical therapy, specialized nursing, or social services

tasks.design: She still orders the supportive care, including physical therapy, specialized nursing care, and social services, from the patient's need. Entering that order in the {OTHER} clinical record she already uses is the order, not a second entry. The therapist, the nurse, and the social service then do their own work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Which supportive service to order depends on this patient's neurological need, and on what that service can actually do.
tasks.enabler_now: Medicine checks and consult notes in this group are other tasks. Ordering physical therapy, specialized nursing, or social services stays her order.
tasks.still_hard: A patient who needs nursing at home and a ward that can still manage, or the reverse.
tasks.human_edge: She can tell which supportive service the patient needs and which one would add burden without helping.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still orders the supportive care. She gains no right to let a default service stand in for that order.

reach.task: Provide the physical therapy she ordered
reach.learn: Which detail of the order she must still set, and which one the therapist sets

evidence.claim: Ordering physical therapy, specialized nursing, or social services is her clinical order for this patient. A medicine interaction check is a different task.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: she places the order in the {OTHER} clinical record she already uses. The fields are the service and the reason, which she supplies. No new producer is added.
If that record is down, she gives the same order in person to the team. That is the same order, not labour this task removes.
She does not re-enter the order in a second system. Delivery by the therapist, the nurse, or the social service is their work and is not in her share.
This task does not include a letter to an outside agency. No send is removed.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
The order keeps its full share. Nothing in this task is removed.
unknowns: Whether a ward clerk already types the order after she has said it.
research_questions: Which supportive care orders does she still have to make herself?

already_counted.description: She still orders physical therapy, specialized nursing, or social services.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still orders the supportive care for this patient in the record she already uses. If a clerk types it, her time is not reduced by this design. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Nothing in these tasks leaves her. Coordinating the team, advising another physician, sitting the continuing education, and ordering supportive care stay her week. She gains no right to skip the conversation, the advice, the activity, or the order.
skills_to_grow: Coordinate neurological services from this patient's course, not from a timetable.
Advise another physician only after she has heard the neurological problem.
Maintain and expand competence by attending the activity, not by counting it.
Order supportive care only after she has judged which service the patient needs.
role.ambitious_version: She still coordinates every team fit, still advises on the neurological problem, still participates in the continuing education, and still orders the supportive care herself. She does not gain a right to let a note or a default service stand in for that work.
